Reliance, Rolls-Royce Ink Deal for AMCA Jet Engine Production in India

Reliance Industries and Rolls-Royce have signed a significant deal to jointly produce jet engines for the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) in India. This collaboration aims to develop and manufacture the engine for the AMCA, a fifth-generation fighter jet being developed by the Aeronautical Development Agency (ADA). The agreement marks a key step towards indigenous defense manufacturing capabilities for India's future air force.
